# Index

## Description

GitHub configuration for this repository: code ownership for review routing and
templates for new issues and pull requests.

## Folders

- [`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) — Provides templates for readers opening an issue.
- [`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/`](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/README.md) — Provides the template contributors complete when opening a pull request.

## Files

- [README.md](README.md) — Describes this folder and lists its subfolders and files.
- [`CODEOWNERS`](CODEOWNERS) — Routes changes to the responsible reviewers; documentation paths go to the documentation reviewers.
